title: New Traffic Flow Model with Nonlinear Anticipation and Intelligent-control Boundary: Existence, Long-time Behavior and Large-relaxation-time Limit
summary: In this paper, we propose a novel physical model for traffic flow incorporating nonlinear anticipation effects and an intelligent-control boundary, mathematically formulated as a damping boundary condition: \begin{align*} \begin{cases} u_t^τ+v_x^τ=0, & x\in(0,1),\; t>0,\\[1mm] v_t^τ+g(u_x^τ)u_x^τ=\dfrac{f(u^τ)-v^τ}τ, & x\in(0,1),\; t>0,\\[1mm] (u^τ,v^τ)(x,0)=(u_0^τ(x),v_0^τ(x)), & x\in(0,1),\\[1mm] u_x^τ(0,t)=0,\quad u_x^τ(1,t)=-ku_t^τ(1,t), & k>0,\; t>0, \end{cases} \end{align*} where $f$ and $g$ are smooth functions satisfying suitable structural assumptions, and $τ>0$ is the relaxation…
